meta.title: Support VM Reuse with Different Compiled Code
meta.body_summary: Add RunCode method to VM for reusing VMs with compiled code, improving performance for sequential script execution.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor added RunCode method with tests; author self-merged after iterative improvements without formal perf evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1555 changed lines, this is a medium-sized addition, with test code making up a large portion (vm_test.go ~788 lines). It is a moderate feature that merged quickly with no review friction.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review feedback; only Codecov bot commented on coverage.
review_details.performance_claim: VM reuse with different compiled code improves performance by avoiding VM reinitialization overhead.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding a VM method like RunCode requires understanding of Go, concurrency, VM lifecycle, and compilation pipeline. Cursor successfully delivered a working implementation with tests, showing capability in language runtime internals.

detection_detail.code_reading: Author/maintainer reviewed and refined the code through multiple commits after the initial agent submission.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling data; performance improvement claimed but not measurable from PR artifacts.

core_change_summary.description: Added RunCode method to VirtualMachine struct to allow executing different compiled code objects without recreating the VM. Introduced runCompiledCode, adjusted state fields (e.g., code, constants), added tests, and provided a design doc and example.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Design document and example were added for documentation; risor.go updated to utilize new method.
change_trajectory: Initial commit by Cursor: Added RunCode method, test file, and design doc.
Maintainer committed formatting, moved design doc, and made significant refactoring and adjustments to more fully support VM reuse, including adding an example.
All changes self-approved and merged within ~12 hours.

review_signals.summary: Codecov bot reported patch coverage 70.49% with 36 lines missing coverage. No blocking.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor initiated PR with RunCode implementation and tests.
Maintainer (myzie) iterated on design doc, code refactoring, and added example within ~12 hours before self-merging.
